Job Description
 If you are a Data Analyst professional looking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you. In this role, you will support transportation and logistics initiatives across the EMEA region, helping drive supply chain efficiency through data analysis, reporting, process optimization, and cross-functional collaboration. You will contribute to data-driven decision-making that enhances operational performance, supports continuous improvement, and delivers value across Emerson’s global supply chain network.
 In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:
 Create, maintain, and enhance recurring and ad hoc reports using Microsoft Excel and analytics platforms. 
 Analyze transportation and logistics data to identify trends, opportunities, and operational improvements. 
 Generate and standardize reports aligned with logistics performance metrics and business objectives. 
 Monitor and report on carrier performance metrics and transportation KPIs. 
 Support transportation rate requests and coordinate with logistics teams, service providers, support teams, manufacturing sites, and sales offices. 
 Conduct cost analyses and rate comparisons to support sourcing decisions and transportation strategies. 
 Gather, maintain, and distribute logistics-related data, including market trends and fuel surcharge information. 
 Provide analytical and operational support for transportation-related inquiries across multiple transportation modes. 
 Maintain and update team collaboration and information-sharing platforms. 
 Consolidate and analyze data from various systems and sources to support business decisions. 
 Track and report on key logistics performance indicators, including on-time delivery, cost savings, and sourcing efficiency. 
 Support data collection and reporting from transportation management systems and carrier platforms. 
 Develop comparative studies and analytical insights to support transportation mode selection and optimization initiatives. 
 Assist logistics team members with data preparation and pricing analyses for sourcing and procurement activities. 
 Who You Are:
 You communicate information clearly and effectively, adjusting your approach to meet the needs of different audiences and fostering productive relationships across teams. You are comfortable navigating changing priorities and new challenges, adapting quickly while maintaining focus on achieving objectives. You analyze complex information from multiple sources, identify meaningful insights, and use sound judgment to support decision-making. You value collaboration, actively contribute to team success, and appreciate diverse perspectives in creating innovative solutions.
 For This Role, You Will Need:
 Experience supporting supply chain, logistics, transportation, operations, analytics, or related business functions. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data and identify actionable insights. 
 Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience working with data reporting tools. 
 Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail. 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. 
 Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global environment. 
 A proactive approach to learning, continuous improvement, and delivering high-quality results. 
 Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:
 Experience in logistics, transportation, or supply chain analytics. 
 Familiarity with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Oracle Analytics Cloud, Tableau, or Power BI. 
 Knowledge of transportation management systems, including Oracle Transportation Management or similar platforms. 
 Exposure to electronic data exchange technologies such as EDI, XML, or API integrations. 
 Experience creating KPI dashboards, performance reports, and cost analysis studies. 
 Understanding of transportation sourcing, carrier management, or freight optimization processes. 
 Our Culture and Commitment To You:
 At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
